memory-cache.In-memory cache store, local to each API: In-memory cache store, local to each API node. Used when selected as the default cache helper.
memory-cache.Time (in milliseconds) an entry stays in: Time (in milliseconds) an entry stays in the cache. 0 disables expiry.
memory-cache.Maximum number of entries kept in the ca: Maximum number of entries kept in the cache before the least recently used ones are evicted.
